text: A plumbing build's test results come back inside the agent's tool limit (#397, #404). Sandbox.Run runs an embedded standard-library Python runner in the pinned image: it compiles each touched package's test binary once, serially, with GOMAXPROCS=2 and -p=1, and reuses it for discovery, tests and acceptance. Eight workers pull top-level tests from one shared queue, those with no recorded time first in package/name order, then the rest longest first, by times the runner keeps in the build's own Go cache as untrusted hints that change only the order. A run has twelve minutes from entry and its test phase ten, renewed by neither a cold cache nor another test, with a one-minute startup and fifteen-second cleanup reserve: 13 min 15 s, under the agents' 900-second tool limits. Results are kept per package, test and phase as passed, failed, skipped, running or not_run, and a deadline returns them as a failed result. A plan's check rejects an acceptance test that already passes, a deadline or interruption, and acceptance evidence that never completed; only the testing package's own marked reports count, so text a test binary prints before its tests start stays a diagnostic. Each container has 4 GiB and 1,024 processes, and on the pinned image two cold runs at once passed in 9 min 30 s and three in 10 min 32 s, none above 1.26 GB or 420 processes. It keeps D-0110's touched packages and pinned image, and replaces its single go test run.
